topic.name: 衰变的统计与用途
topic.title: 不确定的单次衰变，怎样成为可测的时间与路径？
topic.question: 不确定的单次衰变，怎样成为可测的时间与路径？
topic.description: 从氡的半衰期计数，理解磷示踪和碳14理想测年的信号与偏差。

sources.title: IAEA — Nuclear techniques for cultural heritage

zh: 不确定的单次衰变，怎样成为可测的时间与路径？
en: How can unpredictable decays measure time and transport?

translations.不确定的单次衰变，怎样成为可测的时间与路径？: How can unpredictable decays measure time and transport?
translations.从氡的半衰期计数，理解磷示踪和碳14理想测年的信号与偏差。: Connect radon counting with phosphorus tracing and ideal carbon dating.

cues.title: 先看一组核的变化
cues.caption: 不能预报哪个核先衰变，但可以统计剩余数量。
cues.captionEn: The next nucleus to decay is unpredictable, but the remaining number can be counted.
cues.zh: 把视线放到一组氡原子核。各个核的衰变时刻不相同，不能提前指出下一个是谁。固定同一组模拟原子，观察剩余数量逐渐下降。经过大约一个半衰期，预期剩余一半；小样本的实际剩余数可以偏离这个比例，半衰期不是每个核的寿命。
cues.en: Follow one ensemble of radon nuclei. Individual decay times differ; the next event cannot be predicted. Keep the same simulated ensemble and count the survivors. After one half-life, half are expected to remain, but a small sample may differ. A half-life is not the lifetime of every nucleus.

cues.title: 把计数与期望曲线比较
cues.caption: 每经过同样的半衰期，剩余数量的期望再减半。
cues.captionEn: Each equal half-life halves the expected remaining population.
cues.zh: 延长观察时间，把离散计数与平滑的期望曲线放在一起。经过两个半衰期，预期剩下四分之一；三个半衰期，剩下八分之一。换一组原子，细小起伏会改变，统计规律仍然相同。本页用氡二二二约三点八天的半衰期作教学时间标尺，忽略后续子体的计数贡献。
cues.en: Extend the observation and compare discrete counts with the smooth expectation. Two half-lives leave one quarter on average, and three leave one eighth. Another ensemble changes the fluctuations but retains the law. Radon two-twenty-two’s roughly three-point-eight-day half-life sets the teaching timescale; daughter contributions are omitted.

cues.title: 给磷的迁移加上标记
cues.caption: 放射性磷随磷的化学过程迁移，探测信号显示它到达哪里。
cues.captionEn: Radioactive phosphorus follows phosphorus chemistry and reveals where it travels.
cues.zh: 教材用放射性磷研究棉花吸收磷肥。示踪原子随土壤中的磷进入根，再迁移到茎叶。我们比较各部分信号，而不是把整株植物画成可见发光。右侧比例采用分区迁移模型；它说明示踪思路，不代表某种棉花在真实土壤中的吸收速率。
cues.en: The textbook uses radioactive phosphorus to investigate fertilizer uptake by cotton. Tracer atoms move from soil into roots and then shoots. Measurements compare signals in the compartments; the plant does not visibly glow. A compartment model illustrates tracing, without claiming a measured uptake rate for a crop or soil.

cues.title: 迁移之外，还要校正衰变
cues.caption: 各部位总信号会随衰变减少，不能把减少全当成养分流失。
cues.captionEn: Total signal decreases through decay as well as movement between compartments.
cues.zh: 观察右侧三部分的总和，它会随着放射性衰变下降。某一部位的信号减少，既可能因为迁移，也可能因为核已经衰变。把同一时刻的各部位作归一化比较，才能分清这两个原因。模型把磷三十二的衰变与土壤、根、茎叶之间的迁移同时计算。
cues.en: The sum of the three signals decreases as the tracer decays. A falling signal in one compartment can reflect transport or radioactive decay. Comparing normalized compartment fractions at the same time separates these effects. The model calculates phosphorus thirty-two decay together with transport among soil, roots and shoots.

cues.title: 停止交换以后，比例下降
cues.titleEn: After exchange stops, the ratio falls
cues.caption: 古木与环境停止交换碳后，碳14相对含量逐渐降低。
cues.captionEn: After a wood sample stops exchanging carbon, its relative carbon-fourteen content decreases.
cues.zh: 活着的植物与环境交换碳。死亡后，理想封闭样品不再补充新的碳十四，而原有的碳十四继续衰变。比较样品与参考的同位素比例，就可以在这个理想模型中反推经过的时间。木头的年轮只是样品外形，页面计算使用同位素比例，并不是数年轮。
cues.en: Living plants exchange carbon with their environment. After death, an ideally closed sample receives no replacement carbon fourteen while its original carbon fourteen decays. Its isotope ratio relative to a reference gives elapsed time in this ideal model. The wood rings depict the sample; the calculation uses isotope ratios, not ring counting.

cues.title: 加入一点现代碳，再算一次
cues.caption: 现代碳提高测得的碳14比例，使理想推断年龄偏年轻。
cues.captionEn: Modern carbon raises the measured carbon-fourteen ratio and biases the inferred age younger.
cues.zh: 保持古木的真实模型年龄不变，逐渐混入少量现代碳。测得的碳十四比例升高，按纯样品公式推断的年龄就偏年轻。真实测年还要处理初始比例变化、储库效应和校准。本页的年数是简化衰变年龄，不是经过校准的考古年代。
cues.en: Keep the sample’s true model age fixed and mix in a small modern-carbon fraction. The measured carbon-fourteen ratio rises, so a pure-sample inversion gives a younger age. Real dating also addresses changing initial ratios, reservoir effects and calibration. These displayed years are ideal decay ages, not calibrated archaeological dates.
